alerts: Punta Vaca has partial shade and includes three 10' tables, a cement BBQ, a fire circle with benches, and a drinking fountain with spigot. Two chemical toilets are available at site and flush toilets and showers are available nearby. SITE ACCESS: Punta Vaca is located in the family campground. All rules of the campground apply.

PARKING AND VEHICLES: 15 Parking passes will be emailed 5-10 days before your reservations begins. Additional passes are not available for purchase. Buses, RVs, trailers, food trucks, or caterers are prohibited. Violators may be cited and/or towed.

ALCOHOL: Beer and wine allowed. No hard alcohol. Selling of alcoholic beverages, or consumption outside of your designated campsite is subject to citation. Anyone consuming alcohol is subject to state and local guidelines.
